apply_quant_noise_to_linear: apply quantization noise to an nn.Linear module with a given noise probability and block size
apply_quant_noise_to_embedding: apply quantization noise to an nn.Embedding module with a given noise probability and block size
apply_quant_noise_to_conv2d: apply quantization noise to an nn.Conv2d module with a given noise probability and block size
register_forward_pre_hook_for_quant_nois: register a forward pre-hook on a module that randomly drops weight blocks during training
summarize_quant_noise: summarize the quant_noise function that applies block-wise quantization noise to PyTorch module weights
